info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to make a sound, to shout

examples: 'AnardaM nardataH samyak tadA sUyaM Bavizyati' (BA0 u0 141.47). Anardo mahAnAdaH. Ramulantamiti nIlakaRWaH. sUyam ityasya sTAne satyamiti kvacitpAWaH
'mahAmeGaM mahAGoraM darduraH prati nardati' (BA0 karRa0 39.26). pratinardati prAtiBawyena nardati rOti.
